model_annotation: The bar chart displays the overall performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) in the ABS-AOS pattern, with each bar representing a distinct model or group. The vertical axis, labeled "Overall Performance (%)", ranges from 0 to 60 with major tick marks at intervals of 20, and the horizontal axis lists the categories (models) in a specific order, though their labels are not visible in the chart. The bars are color-coded and arranged from left to right in descending order of performance. The tallest bar on the far left reaches 61.09%, followed by 60.72%, then 54.83%, 48.83%, 48.28%, 46.36%, 44.09%, 43.79%, 43.54%, and the shortest bar at 24.64% on the far right. The performance values are explicitly labeled on top of each bar. According to the caption, these performances are stratified into three tiers based on the global mean performance (OP_{GM}): Tier-1 includes models with OP_{GM} in [55, 61], Tier-2 in [41, 49], and Tier-3 in [25, 27]. The chart visually groups models by performance level, with the first two bars (61.09% and 60.72%) falling into Tier-1, the next five bars (54.83% down to 43.79%) falling into Tier-2, and the last two bars (43.54% and 24.64%) falling into Tier-3. The chart does not highlight any specific bar with additional visual emphasis such as bolding or shading.
